results.note: the query string does not choose the file
conditional request headers are not honoured
a plus is a literal plus
a path ending in / names that directory's index.html
a directory without the slash is no file
encoded slashes and a dot-dot segment
double encoding: a % left after one decode
a symlink to a file inside the directory: served, typed by the real file's name
